fact: A provisional constitutional decree signed by Sovereign Council chair al-Burhan in early November 2026 amended Article 51(a) of the 1991 Criminal Act so that electronic and media publishing falls within the crime of waging war against the state, punishable by death or life imprisonment, drawing criticism from rights groups and the journalists' syndicate.
title: يشمل النشر الإلكتروني وعقوبته الإعدام.. كيف قرأ السودانيون تعديلا على القانون الجنائي؟
